environment.description: Terraform provider bridge deployed on ECS Fargate with public ALB. IAM task role has full DynamoDB access (dynamodb:* on arn:aws:dynamodb:us-east-1:*:table/terraform-*). WebSocket endpoint exposed on port 8443 via ALB with no origin restrictions. No WAF attached. Security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 inbound on 443.
